caption:
Can ¥5,000 a night buy you privacy in Namba? We checked real prices for the same nights 🏨

🛏️ Wednesday: a single with its own bathroom, ~600 m from Namba Station, about ¥5,000
🧳 Capsule nearby the same night: about ¥3,200
📈 Saturday: the cheapest private room within 1 km was over ¥11,000, so ¥5,000 only bought a capsule

Our pick: book Namba Sunday to Thursday, or take the capsule on Saturday.
